name: Adeline
description: Adeline is a cathar of Innistrad, a tactician and leader of cathars who worked with the Dawnhart Coven to reverse the Eternal Night.

bio.text: Selected to lead cathars during the Travails, she left her family, and after Emrakul was sealed away she began a personal crusade against vampires.

citations.text: "Adeline", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She joined Arlinn and the Gatewatch in the search for the Moonsilver Key, charging the undead horde at Thraben with her cathars.

citations.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: At the Harvesttide festival she commanded the cathars in shield walls against Tovolar's werewolves.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

bio.text: After Olivia took the Key and the Eternal Night began, she helped carry the wounded Arlinn to the Celestus and agreed to seek out Sorin, hoping a trace of Avacyn remained in him.

"Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
timeline.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
timeline.quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
timeline.quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
timeline.quote: "Here's your man," she says.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
timeline.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline is selected to lead cathars in the Travails, leaving her family; vampires abduct townsfolk including her younger brother.
timeline.quote: A family of vampires took advantage of the chaos and abducted several townsfolk—including Adeline's younger brother

citation.text: "Adeline", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Once Emrakul is sealed away, Adeline begins a personal crusade against vampires.
timeline.quote: Adeline started a personal crusade against the vampires

citation.text: "Adeline", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key, and Adeline joins them to investigate Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda of the Dawnhart Coven recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group finds Thraben destroyed and full of zombies, and Kaya scouts alone and finds a clue about the Key.
timeline.quote: They find the city destroyed and full of zombies

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adeline rides at the vanguard killing zombies as the group reaches Bishop Worrin Betzold.
timeline.quote: Adeline on her horse went to the vanguard of the group, killing several zombies

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival; Teferi delays the sunset and cathars led by Adeline fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar began his attack on the Harvesttide festival

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the witches' ritual and takes the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows the sunset while Adeline and Chandra organize defense and Kaya delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Knowing that they would be overpowered when it became night, Teferi slowed the sunset.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key; they begin in Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline kills a vampire and Chandra burns his body; the two share a moment of respite.
timeline.quote: As she drives her sword through the vampire's heart

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
timeline.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
timeline.quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline agrees to go to Sorin, hoping a trace of Avacyn remains in him, and comforts the boy from Karo.
timeline.quote: "I'll go. If there's a trace of Avacyn left in him, he'll listen."

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
timeline.quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside, Chandra and Adeline see golden light and the invitation wards crumbling.
timeline.quote: The invitation wards are crumbling.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Teferi burn down the manor's great door, beginning the assault proper.
timeline.quote: soon the door before them is only ash

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline and the group help humans across Innistrad, then reluctantly return to Markov Manor and form a pact with Sorin.
timeline.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adeline saves Chandra from a falling column during the battle.
timeline.quote: Adeline saved Chandra from a falling column

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the balance is restored, Arlinn sees Adeline and Chandra embracing under a willow tree.
timeline.quote: Arlinn observed Adeline and Chandra together

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the balance restored, Arlinn sees Chandra and Adeline together under a willow tree, talking and embracing.
timeline.quote: After the balance between night and day was restored, Arlinn Kord observed Chandra and Adeline together, hidden away under a willow tree as they talked and embraced.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
timeline.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn says farewell to her friends, and Kaya leaves, promising to return for ghost business.
timeline.quote: "It's been nice working with you, Arlinn."

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A team of Arlinn, Teferi, Chandra, Kaya and Adeline obtains the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor and returns to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: obtained the Key from Markov Manor and returned to the Celestus

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds an old book showing the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family.
timeline.quote: Kaya finds an old book showing that the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family by a warlock

citation.text: "Dennick Betzold", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and Adeline find Bishop Worrin Betzold among the zombie army, now a zombie, and get the name Dennick from him.
timeline.quote: Arlinn and her companions manage to get the name Dennick from the bishop

citation.text: "Dennick Betzold", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A ragtag alliance of defenders wages guerrilla warfare.
timeline.quote: they waged desperate guerrilla warfare

citation.text: "Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Adeline admires the light in Chandra's eyes.
relations.quote: the light in Chandra's eyes is beautiful

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

relations.note: They embrace in parting beneath a willow.
relations.quote: only just barely make out their embrace
